title: exfer-honor conformance vector
description: A single { fixture, expect } scenario. Open-ended fixture/expect bodies so a new rule or closed hole ships as a new vector with no schema change (design §9).

rules.description: The R-rules / F-/M-holes this vector pins.

compileTimeOnly.description: true ⇒ enforced by the typecheck gate (F8 type test), not the runtime harness.

fixture.description: Open-ended scenario inputs: quote, candidates, datum, chain/keystore/clock fakes.

expect.description: Open-ended expectations: verdict/outcome, gate row state, delivery count.

deliveries.description: Exact number of times deliver() is invoked (idempotency / single-honor).
